nodes.description: Privileged owner address of the UniswapExchange token contract.
Public mapping of token balances, directly mutated in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spender allowances, written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Whitelisted trade address set only by owner, bypasses the ensure() sale condition.
Maximum number of sells per address, set in init().
Minimum sale amount, set in init().
Maximum sale amount, set in init().
Per-address sale counter incremented on every transferFrom.
Mapping of addresses allowed to sell without condition checks.
Total token supply assigned in the constructor.
Constant token decimals (18) used for supply/limit scaling.
Token name.
Token symbol.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address whitelisted in ensure().
Constructor: mints totalSupply to msg.sender, sets owner, grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Access/whitelist gate that returns true for owner, UNI, pair, tradeAddress or canSale addresses, otherwise enforces condition().
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance checks and raw unchecked balance mutations.
Public approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly.
Internal view enforcing sale count, minimum and maximum sale limits.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied address and calldata.
Owner-only initialization of _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale (also callable to reconfigure limits).
Owner-only batch distribution that computes total = _value * _tos.length and loops over recipients.
Owner-only setter that stores a whitelisted trade address.
Internal pure helper computing the Uniswap pair address via CREATE2 hash.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance keys and owner assignment.
Origin of the transaction (declared untrusted input, not used in this contract).
Block timestamp (declared untrusted input, not used in this contract).
Raw delegatecall to a user-supplied address executing arbitrary code in the token's storage context.
Raw unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value without SafeMath.
Raw unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
Raw unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length used to derive the batch total.
Direct allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value write without zero-first protection.
Recipient parameter of transfer().
Value parameter of transfer().
Source address parameter of transferFrom().
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom().
Amount parameter of transferFrom().
Source address parameter of ensure().
Recipient address parameter of ensure().
Amount parameter of ensure().
Spender parameter of approve().
Amount parameter of approve().
Target contract address parameter of delegate().
Arbitrary calldata parameter of delegate().
saleNum parameter of init().
token (min sale) parameter of init().
maxToken (max sale) parameter of init().
Array of recipient addresses parameter of batchSend().
Per-recipient value parameter of batchSend().
Whitelisted trade address parameter of setTradeAddress().
Loop index i in batchSend().
Local recipient _to derived from _tos[i] in batchSend().

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in transferFrom, so caller identity governs the allowance check.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner, granting arbitrary delegatecall to the privileged account.
init() requires msg.sender == owner before reconfiguring sale limits.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before mass balance mutations.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before whitelisting a trade address.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the deployer the privileged account.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key written by approve().
transfer() passes msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
Caller-supplied address a is the target of the delegatecall, enabling arbitrary code execution.
Caller-supplied calldata b is executed via delegatecall in the token's storage context.
delegate() performs the raw delegatecall op, executing untrusted code with full storage control.
The delegatecall invokes external code that can reenter the token before state is settled.
balanceOf[_from] is read and written by the unchecked subtraction, risking underflow.
User-supplied _value directly reduces balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
transferFrom executes the raw balanceOf[_from] -= _value operation.
_from selects which balance entry is decremented with unchecked arithmetic.
balanceOf[_to] is increased by the unchecked addition, risking overflow.
User-supplied _value is added to balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
_to selects which balance entry receives the unchecked addition.
transferFrom executes the raw balanceOf[_to] += _value operation.
batchSend computes uint total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
_tos.length feeds the unchecked multiplication for the batch total.
_value feeds the unchecked multiplication for the batch total.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value directly.
_spender is the key written in the allowance assignment.
_value is the amount written in the allowance assignment.
transfer() delegates its logic to the internal call transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
_to of transfer() is forwarded as the recipient in transferFrom.
_value of transfer() is forwarded as the amount in transferFrom.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) to pass before moving balances.
_from is evaluated against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale inside ensure().
_to is compared against owner inside ensure() for the whitelist bypass.
_value is passed to condition() from ensure().
owner is one of the whitelisted addresses that bypasses the sale condition in ensure().
tradeAddress is whitelisted in ensure(), bypassing condition() checks.
canSale[_from] allows an address to bypass the sale condition.
ensure() calls condition(_from, _value) when no whitelist entry matches.
_from is used to index _onSaleNum in condition().
_value is compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition().
_saleNum gates the per-address sale count in condition().
_minSale sets the minimum acceptable value in condition().
_maxSale sets the maximum acceptable value in condition().
_onSaleNum[_from] is compared with _saleNum in condition().
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address for the whitelist check.
init() verifies the caller against the owner state variable.
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum.
token parameter is scaled and stored into _minSale.
maxToken parameter is scaled and stored into _maxSale.
_minSale is written by init().
_maxSale is written by init().
_saleNum is written by init().
setTradeAddress() verifies the caller against the owner state variable.
The addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress, creating a whitelist bypass address.
batchSend() loop reads each recipient into the local _to variable.
_tos[i] is assigned to the local _to inside the loop.
The batched recipient balance is increased with unchecked addition.
_value is added to each recipient balance without SafeMath in batchSend().
Loop index i drives the batchSend iteration over _tos.

Parameter is the value written by the allowance assignment operation.
Parameter is the target address of the raw delegatecall.
Parameter is the calldata payload of the raw delegatecall.
Parameter is only stored into _saleNum by init().
Parameter is only scaled and stored into _minSale by init().
Parameter is only scaled and stored into _maxSale by init().
Parameter supplies the recipient array iterated over in batchSend().
Parameter is an operand of the unchecked total multiplication.
Parameter is only stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress().
Loop index exists only for the batchSend iteration.
Local recipient is the index of the unchecked balance addition in batchSend().
